what: Proposed findall extracts every Piece N mention after blocked-by, not just comma/and-separated dependency tokens
scenario_or_breakage: A dependencies line like blocked-by Piece 1 (not Piece 2) or blocked-by Piece 1; Piece 2 is independent would incorrectly add a 2 to current edge, causing unnecessary serialization or a false cycle
suggested_fix: Constrain extraction to the declared list grammar: parse only Piece N tokens separated by comma or and, and add a negative fixture with extra prose mentioning another Piece N
